USAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Usage was missing, invalid or inconsistent in Oracle's refusal or the receipt.
QUOTA_RESERVE: The account's allowance is at Jim's reserve.
A normal stop; it clears when the allowance resets.
QUOTA_UNCONFIGURED: The account's allowance has no policy.
Set the quota policy on Oracle.
METER_UNAVAILABLE: The account's allowance cannot be read.
MODEL_DRIFT: Oracle status: the model differs from the pinned one.
BLOCK_NOT_FOUND: A block the card owns is missing.
BLOCK_SHAPE: A card block is not the shape the card expects.
Check the page; the card never edits what it does not own.
RENDER_SHAPE: The rendered card is not the expected shape.
VERIFY_FAILED: The card read-back did not match what was written.
SOURCE_UNREADABLE: The card's source could not be read.
JIRA_BAD_PAGE: A Jira page reply was not the expected shape.
JIRA_CONFIG_INVALID: The Jira board configuration is not valid.
JIRA_TOO_MANY_PAGES: A Jira list ran past the page limit.
None; narrow the query if persistent.
KEY_MISMATCH: The saved Atlassian MCP read is for a different ticket than the one asked about (readiness issue-mcp).
Read the ticket again through the MCP and save the result.
NOTION_CONFIG_MISSING: The Notion token or source id is not configured.
NOTION_HTTP_404: Notion could not find the page or database.
NOTION_NETWORK: The network call to Notion failed.
NOTION_PAGE_ID_INVALID: A Notion page id is not valid.
NOTION_PAGE_INCOMPLETE: A Notion page read was incomplete.
NOTION_PAGINATION_INCOMPLETE: A Notion list did not finish paging.
NOTION_PROPERTIES_INVALID: Notion properties were not the expected shape.
NOTION_RATE_LIMITED: Notion rate-limited the call after retries.
NOTION_SOURCE_INVALID: A Notion data source id is not valid.
NOTION_UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE: A file upload to Notion did not finish.
NOTION_UPLOAD_NETWORK: The network failed during a file upload.
NOTION_UPLOAD_NOT_CREATED: Notion did not create the upload.
NOTION_UPLOAD_SIZE: The file is over Notion's upload size limit.
NOTION_SANDBOX_ACCESS_DENIED: The sandbox proof was denied access.
GRAN_BAD_FRAME: Oracle refused the Granola request as badly framed.
Bug in the V7 caller; nothing was written.
GRAN_BAD_OP: Oracle does not know that Granola operation.
Bug in the V7 caller or Oracle is out of date.
GRAN_NOT_FOUND: Oracle has no such Granola meeting.
Sync again or check the pinned day.
GRAN_SYNC_FAILED: Oracle Claude checks grans on the host.
GRAN_AUTH_EXPIRED: Oracle's Granola session expired (a Mac refresh can sign it out).
Jim signs in again for Oracle; Oracle Claude re-seeds the session.
GRAN_TIMEOUT: Oracle did not answer the Granola request in time.
GRAN_OVERSIZE: The Granola reply was larger than the contract allows.
None; the transcript is not written.
GRAN_HASH_MISMATCH: Oracle refused to purge: the hash did not match its copy.
Look before any retry; nothing was purged.
GRAN_PIPELINE_INCOMPLETE: The Interview OS pipeline could not be read completely.
Repeat the run; nothing was written.
GRAN_TARGET_CONFIG_MISSING: The Interview OS Notion token or pipeline page is not configured for the Granola run.
GRAN_TARGET_NOT_OK: The Interview OS target did not pass its check.
GRAN_ROUND_NOT_MACHINE: The matched round page is not a machine-owned page.
None; Jim's pages are never written.
GRAN_NOTION_FAILED: A Notion call failed during the Granola run.
Repeat the run; look at the page before any Oracle purge.
GRAN_AUTO_FAILED: The automatic Granola run stopped on a fixed code or a failed meeting (counts say which).
Read the counts; repeat after fixing the cause. Nothing is purged from Oracle that is not safely in Notion and the catalog.
PRIVATE_REPORT_FAILED: A private Notion report could not be written (counts say which fixed code).
Read the counts and repeat the run.
PRIVATE_REPORT_KEY_READBACK: The private report page was written but its stored page id did not read back.
Open the page, delete it, and repeat the run.
PHYSMAIL_FILING_FAILED: Filing the Physical Mail notices stopped on a fixed code (counts say which).
Read the counts and repeat the run.
MANUAL_JOB_FAILED: The manual job run stopped on a fixed code (counts say which).
Read the counts, fix the input or the cause, and repeat the run.
MATCH_NONE: No Interview OS round matches this Granola meeting (same Central day plus a company, role, interviewer or domain signal).
None; nothing is written. Check the round's date, company and interviewer.
TRANSCRIPT_WRITTEN: The Full Transcript page was written and read back correctly.
TRANSCRIPT_NOOP: The round already has this exact accepted transcript.
TRANSCRIPT_PLANNED: A dry run planned the Full Transcript write; nothing was written.
Run live when Jim says go.
TRANSCRIPT_WRITE_FAILED: Writing the Full Transcript page to Notion failed.
Check Notion; the run is safe to repeat.
TRANSCRIPT_READBACK_MISMATCH: The written Full Transcript page did not read back as written.
Look at the page before any retry or Oracle purge.
INTERVIEW_OS_DEGRADED: The Interview stage ran with a part failed.
OUTLOOK_BAD_LINK: A paging link pointed off the Graph host, so it was not followed.
A security check; do not follow.
OUTLOOK_CONFIG_INVALID: The Outlook configuration is not valid.
OUTLOOK_DEVICE_START_FAILED: The device sign-in could not start.
OUTLOOK_LISTING_INCOMPLETE: A message listing did not finish paging.
OUTLOOK_NETWORK: The network call to Microsoft failed.
OUTLOOK_SIGNIN_TIMEOUT: The device sign-in was not completed in time.
BAD_JSON: A provider reply was not JSON.
BAD_RESPONSE: A provider reply was not the expected shape.
CAPACITY_READ_FAILED: The capacity card's data could not be read.
CARD_APPEND_MISMATCH: Blocks appended to a card did not read back as written.
CARD_NOT_OWNED: The card block is not one V7 owns, so nothing is changed.
None; the card never edits what it does not own.
CARD_STRUCTURE_CHANGED: The card's structure changed under the write, so it stops.
CARD_VERIFY_FAILED: The card did not read back as written.
CONCURRENT_CHANGE: The page changed while the decision was being written, so it is refused.
DCC_CONTENT_NOT_PRESENT: The expected content is not on the DCC page.
DCC_READ_FAILED: The DCC page could not be read.
DCC_UNCHANGED: The DCC page already matched; nothing was written.
DCC_WRITE_BLOCKED: The DCC write was blocked by a safety check.
Read the reason in the log.
FIT_CLOUD_DEGRADED: The Cloud Fit batch ran with a part failed.
FLOATING_HEADING_AMBIGUOUS: More than one floating heading matches.
FLOATING_HEADING_INVALID: The floating heading is not valid.
FLOATING_PAGE_UNRESOLVED: The page for the floating block could not be resolved.
FLOATING_SHAPE_INVALID: The floating block is not the expected shape.
FLOATING_TABLE_INVALID: The floating table is not valid.
FLOATING_WRAPPED_IN_CALLOUT: The floating block sits inside a callout, so it is not touched.
GCAL_CONFIG_INVALID: The calendar configuration is not valid.
GCAL_HTTP_404: The calendar event is already gone.
GCAL_HTTP_410: The calendar event is already deleted.
GCAL_LISTING_INCOMPLETE: The calendar listing did not finish paging.
GCAL_SIGN_FAILED: The service account token could not be signed.
GDRIVE_CONFIG_INVALID: The Drive credential is not valid.
GDRIVE_NETWORK: The network call to Drive failed.
GDRIVE_OFF_CONTRACT: Drive's reply was not the expected shape.
GDRIVE_SCOPE_NARROW: The stored grant does not allow the action.
GDRIVE_SIZE: The file is over the upload size limit.
GDRIVE_UPLOAD_UNVERIFIED: An uploaded file was not confirmed on read-back.
GMAIL_FILE_LABEL_INVALID: The label for filing mail is not valid.
GMAIL_AMAZON_LABEL_INVALID: The Amazon Gmail label is not valid.
GMAIL_BODY_DECODE_FAILED: A message body could not be decoded.
GMAIL_THREAD_INCOMPLETE: A thread read did not return its messages.
GMAIL_LABEL_READBACK_INCOMPLETE: A label read-back did not finish.
GMAIL_LISTING_INCOMPLETE: A Gmail listing did not finish.
GMAIL_LIST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: A Gmail listing hit its page limit.
GMAIL_LIST_LIMIT_INVALID: The Gmail list limit is not valid.
GMAIL_MESSAGE_INCOMPLETE: A Gmail message came back incomplete.
GMAIL_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: The Gmail profile came back incomplete.
HEADERS_CHANGED: The table headers changed, so nothing is written.
HEADING_CHANGED: The heading changed under the write, so it stops.
HEAD_NOT_FETCHED: The branch head could not be fetched.
HIRING_LEDGER_INCOMPLETE: The Ledger read for Hiring did not finish.
HISTORY_UNREADABLE: The history could not be read.
JOB_PAGE_OUTREACH_PAGES_FAILED: Some job pages failed in outreach.
KEEP_LIST: Branch cleanup: the branch is on the keep list.
KEY_INVALID: The store SSH key is not valid.
MAIL_GMAIL_LISTING_INCOMPLETE: The Gmail listing for mail did not finish.
MAIL_OUTLOOK_LISTING_INCOMPLETE: The Outlook listing for mail did not finish.
MAIL_LEDGER_UNREADABLE: The list of mail already seen could not be read, so the full 14-day scan ran.
None; the next run tries again.
MAIL_LEDGER_NOT_SAVED: The list of mail already seen could not be saved, so that mail is read again next time.
STAGE_CONTRACT_OUTPUT_MISSING: A stage returned counts that are not a dict or lack a key its contract declares.
A code defect in the stage or its contract; fix one of them.
STAGE_CONTRACT_INCOMPLETE: A stage contract has an empty field (name, inputs, outputs, dry-run or write text).
A code defect: fill the field.
MERGED_AND_UNCHANGED: Branch cleanup: merged with no newer commits, so it may be deleted.
MESSAGE_INCOMPLETE: A mail message is incomplete, so the order goes to review.
MESSAGE_INVALID: A mail message is not valid, so the order goes to review.
NEWER_COMMITS_AFTER_MERGE: Branch cleanup: commits exist after the merge, so it is kept.
ALREADY_ARCHIVED: Branch cleanup: the branch is already archived.
ANOTHER_OPEN_PR_USES_IT: Branch cleanup: another open PR uses the branch, so it is kept.
ARCHIVE_NOT_READ_BACK: The archive tag was not confirmed on read-back.
ARCHIVE_PUSH_FORBIDDEN: The token may not push the archive.
ARCHIVE_PUSH_NEEDS_WORKFLOWS_PERMISSION: The push needs the workflows permission.
Grant it or skip the branch.
ARCHIVE_UNREADABLE: The archive could not be read.
BRANCH_ALREADY_GONE: Branch cleanup: the branch is already deleted.
NOT_CONFIGURED: The Hiring card is not configured.
NOT_CONFIRMED: The decision was not confirmed on the screen.
NOT_FOUND: The Interview page was not found.
NOT_MERGED_OR_FORK: Branch cleanup: not merged or from a fork, so it is skipped.
NOT_OWNED: The block is not one V7 owns, so nothing is changed.
None; the card never edits what it does not own.
OUTCOME_MAIL_STALE: Hiring evidence: the outcome mail is stale.
OUTCOME_MAIL_UNREADABLE: Hiring evidence: the outcome mail could not be read.
OUTREACH_AMBIGUOUS: More than one recruiter row matches the outreach.
OUTREACH_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE: The outreach status could not be read.
PAGE_CHANGED: The page changed under the write.
PAGE_DIGEST_INCOMPLETE: The page digest could not be completed.
PARENT_WALK: Step label: walking up to the parent page.
PROTECTED_REGION_CHANGED: Jim's protected content changed during a write, so the write stops.
None; nothing of Jim's is overwritten.
WRITE_OUT_OF_SCOPE: A card tried to write to a block outside its own region; the write was refused before it was sent.
A code defect in the card; nothing was written.
PROTECTED_REGION_UNAVAILABLE: A protected block could not be read, so no write is made.
PROTECTED_REGION_VERIFICATION_FAILED: The protected region did not verify after the write.
PUBLISH_RECORDS_FAILED: The publish records could not be saved.
READBACK_FAILED: A write could not be read back.
READBACK_MISMATCH: A write did not read back as written.
REGION_INSTALL_FAILED: The region could not be installed.
ROUTER_DUPLICATE_MODULE: Two modules claim the same region.
ROUTER_REGION_NOT_OWNED: A module wrote a region it does not own.
STALE_IDENTITY: The page no longer matches the screen that was opened.
STORE_DB_CONNECT_FAILED: None; retried. Persistent: check the store tunnel.
STORE_SSH_BANNER: The store SSH banner did not arrive.
STORE_SSH_JUMP_AUTH: The jump host refused the key.
STORE_SSH_JUMP_DNS: The jump host name did not resolve.
STORE_SSH_JUMP_HOSTKEY: The jump host key does not match.
STORE_SSH_JUMP_KEY_INVALID: The jump host key is not valid.
STORE_SSH_REFUSED: The store SSH connection was refused.
STORE_SSH_TCP_TIMEOUT: The store SSH connection timed out.
STORE_SSH_TIMEOUT: The store SSH call timed out.
TINYFISH_KEY_MISSING: The TinyFish key is not set.
TINYFISH_NETWORK: The network call to TinyFish failed.
TINYFISH_SEARCH_NETWORK: The network call to TinyFish search failed.
TINYFISH_SEARCH_UNREADABLE: A TinyFish search reply could not be read.
HERMES_CONFIG_MISSING: A setting the hermes stage needs is not set (the code names the setting, never a value).
Set the named setting; Jim approves any new credential.
HERMES_CONFIG_INVALID: A hermes stage setting is malformed.
Fix the setting; no value is printed.
HERMES_READBACK_MISSING: A request was published but did not read back from the relay.
Read the channel; retry with the same key (it never duplicates).
HERMES_BUZZ_UNEXPECTED: The relay answered a post with an unknown status.
HERMES_BUZZ_RECIPIENT_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Addressing is off, or the recipient is not approved for this sender.
Jim approves the alias and the sender.
HERMES_BUZZ_RECIPIENT_NOT_CHANNEL_MEMBER: The recipient is not a member of the channel.
Add the recipient to the channel.
HERMES_BUZZ_WRITE_DISABLED: This channel is not in the write allowlist (or the run is a dry run).
Run with --live and an approved channel.
HERMES_BUZZ_COMMUNITY_NOT_AUTHORIZED: The community is not configured for this sender.
HERMES_BUZZ_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED: No member key is configured for the community.
HERMES_BUZZ_INVALID_ARGUMENT: The relay client refused a malformed argument.
HERMES_BUZZ_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: The same idempotency key was used with different text.
HERMES_BUZZ_DELIVERY_UNKNOWN: The relay did not confirm the post.
Read the channel, then retry with the same key; it reads before writing.
HERMES_BUZZ_PRECHECK_UNAVAILABLE: The relay could not answer the read before the write.
HERMES_BUZZ_RELAY_ERROR: The relay answered with a server error.
HERMES_BUZZ_RELAY_UNREACHABLE: The relay could not be reached.
HERMES_BUZZ_RELAY_REFUSED: Check the key and the community.
HERMES_BUZZ_RELAY_BAD_RESPONSE: The relay answered with something unreadable.
DENY_INPUT: The tool request is malformed or a required field is missing.
DENY_PRINCIPAL: The agent, host or session is not a verified one, or the call did not come through the V7 adapter.
Call through the adapter with a valid session.
DENY_UNSUPPORTED_ACTION: The tool is not registered, or the sandbox or workbench action is not supported.
DENY_SECRET_EXPOSURE: A secret-shaped value is in the request or in the tool output; the output is suppressed.
DENY_ACCOUNT_AMBIGUOUS: The account is missing, ambiguous, unknown or not this tool's account.
